typesense:trending.greeting:
*It started small...rumors of strange new heroes and villains popping up in the news. Tense stand-offs on live TV as the Rhino tears through a crowded subway in Gotham pursued by Hal Jordan, the Green Lantern. A frantic back alley struggle at night between Ghost Rider and Batman ending in a stalemate in NYC with helicopters and spotlights circling overhead. The world was changing. We just weren't aware by how much.*

*Dr. Hank McCoy and Reed Richards posited on a new theorum as the rifts started to become more frequent. The tears between two realities were growing, they called it "The Convergence." And it was a harbinger of things to come.*

*It is now three years since the first of the rifts appeared. Human, meta and mutant agencies from both universes have either fractured or pulled together into collaborations to face off against the rise of new terrors. The villains are growing more efficient, working together to achieve goals previously unheard of.*

`It's a new world you are entering into, how you choose to interact is yours to decide. To start, create your character.`

*NAME*

*ALIAS*

*AGE*

*LOCATION*

*META, HUMAN OR MUTANT?*

*ALIGNMENT*

*ARE YOU IN A GROUP ALREADY? IF SO NAME THEM. (I.E. X-MEN, AVENGERS, ETC.)*

*POWERS/ABILITIES*

*BACKSTORY*

*WHAT ARE YOU DOING AT GAME START?*

*AND FINALLY, DO YOU WANT THIS TO BE SFW OR NSFW? A GRITTIER MORE REALISTIC ADULT NARRATIVE WITH SEXUAL RELATIONS, GRAPHIC VIOLENCE, ETC.? OR A DEDICATED COMIC BOOK EXPERIENCE? CHOOSE NSFW OR SFW DEPENDING.*
typesense:trending.name: The Convergence
typesense:trending.title: A Marvel-D.C. event, where both universes begin to bleed together creating a solitary Prime Earth.

title_i18n.de: Ein Marvel-D.C.-Ereignis, bei dem beide Universen zu verschmelzen beginnen und eine einzelne Prime Earth erschaffen.
title_i18n.es: Un evento de Marvel-D.C., donde ambos universos comienzan a mezclarse creando una sola Tierra Prime.
title_i18n.hi: एक मार्वल-डी.सी. घटना, जहां दोनों ब्रह्मांड आपस में घुलने लगते हैं और एक अकेला प्राइम अर्थ बनाते हैं।
title_i18n.ko: 마블-디씨 이벤트로, 두 우주가 서로 스며들어 하나의 프라임 어스를 만들어냅니다.
title_i18n.pl: Wydarzenie Marvel-D.C., w którym oba uniwersa zaczynają się przenikać, tworząc jedną Prime Earth.
title_i18n.pt: Um evento da Marvel-D.C., onde ambos os universos começam a se fundir criando uma única Terra Prime.
title_i18n.ru: Событие Marvel и D.C., где обе вселенные начинают смешиваться, создавая единую Prime Earth.
title_i18n.zh: 漫威-DC事件，两个宇宙开始融合，形成一个单一的原始地球。
